fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Jump-capable platoons provide vertical mobility for urban operations and rough terrain that would slow or halt conventional foot infantry. ComStar deployed jump platoons in specialized roles where their ability to bypass obstacles justified the additional cost of jump equipment and training. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
